summary: This note is the index page for the India and Pakistan AMS Topographic Maps collection in the Perry-Castañeda Map Collection at the University of Texas Library. The maps are the 1:250,000 scale Series U502 produced by the U.S. Army Map Service starting in 1955. The page lists each sheet by its sheet number and place name, with file sizes, and marks some sheets as having a verso map of a vicinity area.
one_line: Index of the U.S. Army Map Service 1:250,000 Series U502 topographic maps of India and Pakistan held in UT Austin's Perry-Castañeda Map Collection.
key_facts: The collection is titled India and Pakistan 1:250,000 and is Series U502 of the U.S. Army Map Service, dated from 1955.
The collection is hosted in the PCL Map Collection of the UT Library Online (Perry-Castañeda Library).
The page provides an Index Map (3.9 MB) and a complete list of map images in the collection.
Sheet NC 43-7 is Coimbatore, and a separate verso sheet titled Coimbatore and Vicinity is listed.
Sheet NC 44-13 is Tuticorin (3.2 MB) and sheet NC 44-1 is Salem (4.5 MB).
Sheet ND 44-13 is Bangalore (4.4 MB) and sheet ND 44-10 is Madras (4.4 MB).
Sheet NE 43-5 is Bombay (3.1 MB) and sheet NE 44-9 is Hyderabad (4.6 MB).
Sheet NF 44-9 is Nagpur (4.6 MB) and sheet NF 45-7 is Calcutta (4.8 MB).
Sheet NG 44-1 is Agra (5.6 MB) and sheet NG 45-2 is Mount Everest (6.2 MB).
Sheet NG 46-2 is Towang (9.4 MB), noted as from the collections of the Library of Congress, the largest file in the list.
Sheet NH 43-16a is Delhi (4.1 MB) and sheet NH 43-16b is Delhi and Vicinity (1.1 MB).
Sheet NH 42-5 is Quetta (5.7 MB) and sheet NH 42-8 is Multan (5.8 MB), both in present-day Pakistan.
Sheet NI 43-6 is Srinagar (5.0 MB) and sheet NI 43-8 is Leh (3.5 MB).
Sheet NJ 43-15 is Shimshal (3.3 MB), the last sheet listed in the collection.
